Critical Mass Tampa Bay

Tampa, FL · Downtown · Social

Critical Mass Tampa Bay is a social group ride in Tampa, FL. It rolls last Friday of the month at 8:00 pm from Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @criticalmass_tampabay the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Critical Mass Tampa Bay group ride

Tampa's monthly mass ride from the downtown waterfront. It leaves at 8 pm sharp. Bring lights, and plenty of them. The organizers' line is that more riders means a safer ride.
